description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/sunset — retires a launched yield deployment: it moves from the active list to the archive and its tenant hosts stop serving it. Drafts cannot be sunset (409; delete them instead). Idempotent. Reversible with yield_deployments_unsunset. Confirm with the user. Requires a fresh JWT.
name: yield_deployments_sunset
title: Sunset a yield deployment
